_comment: Hermes cron jobs for a personal Windows laptop running WSL2. Created only if absent; all output stays local. They fire only while a Hermes gateway runs (opt in with HERMES_INSTALL_GATEWAY=true).

jobs.name: orphan-reaper
jobs.prompt: Silent watchdog: reap idle/orphaned tier tmux sessions and release stuck Paperclip checkouts. Output only when it acts.
